manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball and a ball released from rest at the top fall together. Gravity gives both the same acceleration.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.description: Two lanes show a tossed ball and a second ball held by a gate at the height of the top. Blue arrows show velocity and dashed arrows show acceleration. The gate opens at the top and both balls then fall together.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Use At top to jump to the shared release.
